about_the_game:
SNØ is a game about downhill skiing where you carve your way down various mountainscapes, trying to score as many points as possible by pulling off high-risk maneuvers and tricks. Mastering the controls and terrain is key to achieving high scores, making every run a test of skill and flow.

Whether you're chasing the leaderboard or just enjoying the ride, SNØ offers endless procedural mountains to explore. For those who prefer a more relaxed experience, Zen Mode removes scoring and lets you ski purely for the thrill of the descent.

Message from the creators:

SNØ is made in Norway by two people. We’ve designed it to capture the essence of downhill skiing in a minimalistic, no-nonsense way: focusing on rewarding gameplay systems, smooth controls, and sleek visuals. While SNØ is great for short sessions, many players find themselves going "just one more run" longer than expected.

Hearing from you makes our day! If you have questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out on any of our socials or leave a review.

Special message to all Steamdeck users:

We have optimized SNØ for the Steamdeck. The game runs at 60 FPS on High quality settings. Enjoy.

Things you will find in this game

  • Fast and smooth freeriding gameplay

  • Three ride styles: Skis, Snowboard and Sit-ski

  • Endless procedurally generated mountains

  • Share mountains with the seed based mountain generator

  • Countless skins requiring skills to unlock

  • Full keyboard and gamepad support

  • Optional Zen-mode - No scoring, just you and the mountain

  • Online global and friends leaderboards

  • Visit top scoring mountains directly from the leaderboard

  • First person, third person and drone camera modes

  • Dynamic action cam mode

  • Photo mode

Things you will not find

  • Online multiplayer

  • Prepped slopes

  • Loading times

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can run the demo, you can run the full game
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network for leaderboards
